digest.component_or_area: close precheck / commit linking / CLI write surface
propositions: The attach_commits repair verb must be exposed on all three surfaces (CLI, library, MCP) to retroactively link commits with a deterministic all-or-nothing SHA validation performed at the seam before recording any COMMITS event.

A deterministic close-gate check must compare discovered commits' changed paths against the union of file_impact over the ticket and transitive descendants, blocking close if any path is undeclared and not exempted.

Merge commits must be explicitly skipped during the close check to avoid false passes from empty path lists, while source-(i) remote commits are skipped and source-(ii) local commits fail closed if git show errors.

The glob_match helper supporting **/‐aware path matching must be extracted to a new DET module (commit_impact.py) that imports no rebar.llm, with both existing copies (prompts and registry) delegating to it.

CLI dispatch requires a new variadic verb rebar attach-commits <ticket> <sha>... with pinned help and exit-code documentation, while generated docs (cli-reference.md, mcp-reference.md) must regenerate clean via CI drift gates.

The commit-trailer guide must name the attach-commits verb and the set-file-impact remedy, and the close check skips when no commits are discovered, preserving today's behavior for tickets with no linked commits.
